name: Tetsu
source:
A man came from the main island to investigate the demon that tells the future. Being an old friend of [url=/c89719]Nagi[/url]'s husband, he also has a bit of knowledge about the demons.
Tetsu prepared a variety of materials and tools for the purpose of challenging the demon himself, but [url=/c89666]Kyouko[/url], who provided him accommodation, found out that they are all useless afterward.
A gentle and strong man, dislike being called "old man". He also helped out as an engineer during his time in Haikyo.
